timeline.body: Hi @ivancea, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
This returned a null before (`DataType.fromTypeName("unknown") == null`), I'm just making it obvious

`default` doesn't include nulls for enums (As enums call `v.ordinal()` in switches), and it throws unless an explicit null case is added.
Another interesting thing, is that the `case null, default` syntax is the only way to combine null or default cases!
Could you add a javadoc to this one saying it's null for versions before <WHATEVER VERSION IT IS>?

reply.body: Ah! `<`. I thought that might be a problem.....
